name: Rank list reveal
summary: Up to five ranked rows that reveal one by one from the bottom rank up to #1, with numbered circles.

params.name: y
params.note: centre y; the list grows with the items

params.name: items
params.note: items separated by | ; first item is rank 1, up to 5

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

author: krakujs
